label: Query for the first page
code:
Q_FIRST = """
SELECT id, created_at FROM orders
WHERE restaurant_id = :restaurant_id
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
LIMIT :page_size
"""

label: Query for the page after a cursor
code:
Q_NEXT = """
SELECT id, created_at FROM orders
WHERE restaurant_id = :restaurant_id
  AND (created_at, id) < (:created_at, :id)
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
LIMIT :page_size
"""
